Another reason it is interesting is because it has a twin: ground 2, which operates beside it so that when one moves in one direction, the other will move with it to fill the empty space that would have been left behind. That mechanism was the hardest for me to insert into the game. I've only tried once before to make a scrolling platform and that was extremely glitchy when tampered with.
